title: Hamza was remarkable! We...
text: Hamza was remarkable! We had such an incredible time learning about Alhambra and him. He was knowledgeable, entertaining, and passionate about the history, which we really enjoyed.
author: Mary_W

title: Carlos as a private guide made the difference
text: Fabulous experience in a beautiful historical place and having Carlos as a guide made all the difference. He not only loves his town of origin, but also he’s passionate about its history And instructing people about the greatness of the place. Carlos made all the difference if you can afford him as a private guide, Treat yourself and the experience. You won’t remember how much you paid, but you will always remember what he taught you.
author: SaraC_C

title: A walk through history.
text:
We visited the palaces with Maria as a guide in a group of 4 people and it was wonderful. The communication with Maria prior to the visit was very clear and her historical knowledge is very complete and detailed, plus her sense of humor makes the tour very entertaining! We had a great time, learned a lot, and had an excellent visit in general.

P.S.: Maria is also a great photographer.
author: juliana_o

title: Our guide was amazing! ...
text: Our guide was amazing!  She was very informative and patient. The pace flowed very well.  The palace is a must see.
author: Paul_O

title: Excellent Alhambra tour
text: We had an excellent tour with Richard—it was thoughtful, informative and entertaining. The three hours flew by.  Highly recommended.
author: aimeemackay

title: Fabulous, Knowledgable Guide Who was ACTUALLY Fluent in English
text: Carlos is an exceptional guide. Incredible, deep knowledge of the Alhambra. a passion for history, architecture, gardening and sharing what he knows. Truly fluent in English. I can’t tell you how rare this is. And eager to share his passion with us. He could answer everything I asked and this was my best tour at The Alhambra (and my third trip!). We were very lucky to have a guide like this. If you are deeply interested in learning, this is the guide to have. He is educated and erudite and made this private tour worth every penny, Lucky us!
author: Alisha_G

title: Richard was a great tour...
text: Richard was a great tour guide. We learned a lot about the history of Alhambra. Everything went smoothly and everyone had a great time.
author: Kristin_T

title: Fantastic tour of the Alhambra.
text: This is a comprehensive tour of the Alhambra, including Generallife, Alcazar, and the Nasrid Palace. In 3 1/2 hours, we learned a great deal, were able to see everything that we wanted, and were given great insights into history and local culture. Our guide, Amine, was outstanding.
author: amesiwalamd

title: Amazing place & tour guide
text: Pablo was a superbly knowledgeable and patient guide , who made the trip special. Really enjoyed it.
author: Gary_H

title: Excellent guide to discover Granada and the Alhambra
text:
Maria made our visit to Granada and the Alhambra much more than a tourist tour. Her explanations were clear, interesting, and full of historical and cultural details that really help you understand what you are seeing, without making the visit heavy at any time.

She took us at a very good pace through the Alhambra, its palaces and gardens, answering our questions and pointing out those small details that would easily go unnoticed. It is clear that she knows the history of the place deeply and, above all, that she enjoys sharing it.
